item.title: Windy Wednesday brings near-record warmth, increased fire risk
item.description: A cold front moved through Saturday, and now we are on the cooler, sunnier side of it for Sunday and Monday.

item.title: 2026 State of the Union Texas guests included Coast Guard rescue swimmer, 11-year-old flood survivor
item.description: President Donald Trump held his first State of the Union address to Congress (SOTU) of his second term on Tuesday, and in it he spoke briefly about the July 4, 2025 floods in Central Texas.

item.title: Man found fatally shot at Willowbrook apartment complex, HPD says
item.description: A man was shot and killed at an apartment complex in the Greenspoint area of Houston, police said.

item.title: AMBER Alert discontinued after missing 12-year-old found, suspect arrested
item.description: Authorities said a suspect connected with a local AMBER Alert was arrested, and a missing 12-year-old was found safe.

item.title: Man charged with secretly giving woman abortion drug in The Woodlands, deputies say
item.description: A man in The Woodlands has been charged with secretly giving his girlfriend who experienced a miscarriage an abortion drug.

item.title: Singer D4vd is 'target' in investigation of killing of girl whose body was found in car in Hollywood
item.description: Houston-born singer D4vd is at the center of a Los Angeles grand jury investigation of the killing of a 14-year-old girl found dead in a Tesla.

item.title: RodeoHouston begins with Dirt Day tradition in Houston
item.description: Dirt Day marks the official start of preparations for RODEOHOUSTON at NRG Stadium, as volunteers, officials, and rodeo leadership gather to pour fresh dirt into the arena and prepare the surface for world-class rodeo athletes and animals.

item.title: Harris County immigrant legal services program can continue, appeals court rules
item.description: Harris County started the Immigrant Legal Services Fund in 2020, initially allocating $2.5 million to helping people navigate immigration proceedings.

item.title: Rep. Al Green explains why he protested during Trump’s State of the Union
item.description: Rep. Al Green spoke with CW39’s Sharron Melton the morning after he was escorted out of the House chamber during President Trump’s State of the Union address. Green said he intentionally protested to confront what he described as “unacceptable” behavior and said he was prepared to face any consequences.

item.title: Houston Texans unveil first look at Toro District in Bridgeland
item.description: The Houston Texans will give everyone its first look at plans for the Toro District, a new district that will be located in northwest Harris County.
